modules.title: Modules and safety
modules.description: Independent read-only modules. Snapshot skew compares HA report times, not upstream freshness. Budget counts simulated requests only.

vehicle.title: Logical vehicle
vehicle.description: Add one record per physical vehicle, then attach its provider devices.

provider.title: Provider device
provider.description: Attach Custom first and Fleet as fallback, or any supported HA device. Confirm discovered fields in the next step.

fields.title: Review discovered fields
fields.description: Only unambiguous semantic registry fields are suggested. Select missing fields explicitly. Each field falls back independently.

site.title: Price Engine consumer site
site.description: Select the independent authoritative producer. EV Charge Manager never calculates tariffs or fetches market data for this site. Missing/stale producer data makes forecasts unavailable.

charger.title: Charger observation
charger.description: Select the physical status sensor. Power alone cannot establish physical disconnect.

remove.title: Remove configuration
remove.description: Removing a vehicle also removes its provider links.

edit.title: Edit configuration
edit.description: Vehicle identity is preserved. IDs are stable; editing provider fields retains device association.

manage_provider.title: Manage provider
manage_provider.description: Changes affect this logical vehicle only; its identity remains unchanged.

provider_action.title: Provider action
provider_action.description: Primary/up/down change read priority. Removal fails closed for missing fields. Replacement requires a new device and reviewed field mappings.

provider_device.title: Replace provider device
provider_device.description: Select the replacement device, then review its fields. Existing vehicle identity and provider position are retained.

legacy_site.title: Migration/reference pricing site (frozen)
legacy_site.description: Select either official Nord Pool or a timestamped price sensor. Grid, tax and supplier are DKK/kWh excluding VAT. Select all_in only for a complete price; set all additions and VAT to zero. No vehicle commands are sent.

data.name: Name
data.grid_tariff_entity: Optional grid tariff schedule sensor (slots, DKK/kWh ex VAT)
data.guest_power_entity: Optional measured guest demand (W or kW)
data.dso_mode: Grid source (manual or verified Radius C)
data.danish_public_rates: Use issue-verified Danish public rates for their documented dates

policy.title: Provider policies (control remains disabled)
policy.description: Fallback may select a supported provider before dispatch. An uncertain write is never retried through another provider. Removed explicit providers fail closed until reviewed.

command_fields.title: Review service targets (control stays disabled)
command_fields.description: Map only verified device capabilities. No service is called by saving. A matching switch report is not proof of actual energy delivery.

discover_charger.title: Choose charger device
discover_charger.description: Suggest a status only when registry semantics are unambiguous; review every field before saving.

access_policy.title: Choose a vehicle, charger or site

access_fields.title: Availability and eligibility (read-only)
access_fields.description: Disabling excludes managed plans, not physical plug observation or retained history. Restrictions permit only the selected sites/vehicles; an empty restricted list permits none. Guest permission remains simulated and manual. Limits never authorize hardware commands.

manual_association.title: Review current plug-session identity
manual_association.description: Select the physically connected known vehicle. Review applies only to the current plug session; it cannot replace a guest permission or another charger reservation. No hardware command or production authorization is issued. Save configuration edits before reviewing.

error.invalid_mapping: Invalid mapping, duplicate identity, timezone or price configuration.
error.duplicate_device: This device is already linked to a logical vehicle.
error.duplicate_physical_vehicle: Exact registry identity matches a provider on another logical vehicle. Add this device to that vehicle instead.
error.conflicting_physical_vehicle: Registry identity conflicts with this logical vehicle. Review the physical vehicle before linking this provider.
error.unsafe_association: Session changed, source is stale, eligibility failed or another session owns this vehicle. Review current states and save configuration changes first.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Use Configure to change options.
abort.not_loaded: Load the integration before reviewing a physical session.

simulate_guest_authorization.name: Simulate guest authorization
simulate_guest_authorization.description: Authorizes only this integration’s simulated guest session. Sends no physical command.

simulate_probe.name: Simulate ambiguity probe
simulate_probe.description: Evaluates supplied synthetic samples only. Does not command or observe real hardware.

simulate_command.name: Simulate command
simulate_command.description: Validates and records an intent with no hardware transport. Budget is an estimate, not Fleet usage.

simulate_vehicle_association.name: Simulate reviewed vehicle association
simulate_vehicle_association.description: Review known identity for a current eligible physical plug session; no commands or production authority.
